text: The Resilient Homes Fund (RHF) is a Queensland Government initiative, co-funded with the Australian Government, aimed at reducing household flood risk and accelerating recovery for homeowners affected by the 2021–22 Queensland flood events. The fund provides tailored packages for repairing, retrofitting, raising, demolishing, rebuilding, or voluntarily buying back severely flood-affected properties. It operates under the Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) and involves multiple public agencies and local councils.
